messages:
alexa_cs: quick heads up — BlueFork renewal is ready to sign but procurement returned a PO that doesn't match contract entity. PO: `BF-2026-77` shows "BlueFork EU" while contract is set up for "BlueFork US". @lina_legal can you advise? docusign link (internal): https://docusign.example/envelopes/0xabc :thinking_face:

lina_legal: looking now. if PO is for EU entity we either need an amendment or a reissued PO. revenue/recognition will care. can we ask them to reissue?

mike_sales: spoke to Ben (customer). procurement prefers reissue but slow — ~3-5 business days. he offered a temporary workaround: pay first month by CC so we can start onboarding, procurement will reissue PO afterwards. he asked if we can e-sign now and swap invoice entity later.

ramon_ops: quick ops note — if signature goes through with mismatched entity, billing system will block invoice until PO matches. we could manually create a pro-forma invoice, but finance will flag it. CC payment for initial month is safest to avoid hold. :warning:

alexa_cs: Ben willing to CC for month1. plan A: CC now, DocuSign for contract, PO reissued and we attach to invoice when available. plan B: hold signing until PO fixed. which do we want?

lina_legal: plan A ok with me if we add a short amendment clause to cover entity swap and attach reissued PO within 30 days. i'll draft a one-pager amendment and add to the envelope. also need vendor code on PO for our side.

mike_sales: i'll ask Ben to confirm vendor code and slack it here. i'll also request procurement to reissue with correct entity.

alexa_cs: sending DocuSign in ~15m with amendment placeholder. envelope will require `Company Signer` + `CFO` roles. if they push back we can accept wet-sign scanned PDF as fallback.

docusign-bot: Envelope 0xabc created by alexa_cs. status: awaiting signatures. reminder scheduled in 48h.

lina_legal: thumbs up. alexa, include this language: "Customer shall deliver reissued PO referencing the original order number within 30 days; failure to provide will result in invoice hold and potential suspension." short and explicit.

ramon_ops: noted. ops will mark the account as "pending PO match" after signing until finance confirms receipt of reissued PO. we'll proceed with onboarding tasks that don't require billing clearance.

alexa_cs: thanks — i'll message Ben with CC payment instructions and send envelope. will follow up here once signed or if procurement responds. :thumbsup:
